cityMap:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: approval-only revised illustrated city map for Mayhem Meadows; NOT an applied game asset.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the original 1536 x 1024 city map. Preserve its exact overhead framing, north orientation, coastline, river, islands, mountain contours, airport, road network, parks, labels and district positions. Keep all terrain and neighborhoods unchanged except narrow new rail corridors and a small station redevelopment within northern Docklands. Output one 1536 x 1024 landscape map with no page border, no inset panels.
Primary request: add a coherent railway, a compact passenger terminus, freight sidings, visibly correct road crossings, and an optional depot-roof helipad, matching the existing detailed cartographic painting style.

Use original pixel coordinates measured from upper-left as a placement guide. Railway enters the NORTH EDGE on land just WEST of the Rivermere River at approx (963,0), curves gradually southeast through (1030,70), (1100,130), (1118,185), then follows west-bank LAND through (1090,250), (1070,300), (1070,355), (1050,415), (1050,475), (1060,535), (1080,580). Keep tracks well inside the riverbank, never in water and never on the airport side. Two parallel dark steel railway tracks with fine pale sleepers and narrow muted tan ballast, visually distinct from black roads and orange freeways. Use smooth railway curves, no street-like hairpins.
A southwest branch curves from (1080,580) through (1060,600), (1025,620), then straight WEST into a passenger TERMINUS at roughly x900..1020, y615..650. Two short platform tracks with platform canopies and buffers at the west end; station concourse on their NORTH side, facing Downtown. Redevelop only that northern Docklands warehouse strip; preserve docks south of y690 and surrounding roads. Label the building 'CENTRAL STATION'. Add a short pedestrian link north to Downtown through a freeway underpass and a modest taxi/bus forecourt on the north/west side with street access.
Freight branch continues from (1080,580) south along the industrial eastern Docklands edge through (1100,635), (1110,690), (1115,750), splitting into two short stub sidings with clear buffers inside the existing port yard. Tracks remain on existing dry land and do not extend onto piers or into water.
CROSSINGS: where railway meets the northern orange freeway near (1070,319), the central airport bridge approach near (1050,467), and the southern orange freeway near (1068,552), show roads OVER the railway with small credible bridge shadows and intact continuous roads. Do not place level-crossing barriers on freeways. At two quieter freight-yard road crossings near (1102,648) and (1111,711), draw small red-and-white gate barriers and road stop bars perpendicular to the tracks. Retain road continuity and safe pedestrian access to platforms. Every visible road/rail intersection must read as either a bridge or a gated crossing.
HELIPAD OPTION: add a low broad rectangular depot/operations building beside the terminus, around (1015,662), with a modest clearly readable rooftop circle and white 'H', apart from platform canopies and passenger forecourt. No overhead railway wires. Avoid port cranes immediately beside it.
Add a discreet railway sleeper-symbol swatch and 'RAILWAY' to the existing lower-left legend below existing entries, preserving other legend text and title. Keep any new labels few, clear, and correctly spelled. Do not turn this into a transit schematic, do not redraw the city, do not add a metro loop, do not cross airport runway, do not remove or relocate streets, and do not fill the river.
heightmap:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: subtle edited grayscale terrain elevation raster, 1536x1024, approval draft.
The single supplied image is the original HEIGHTMAP, the edit target. Preserve its original framing and all geography, coastline, riverbanks and islands. Keep every water area, river, sea and inlet in exactly its original shape and darkness. NO shoreline extension or land reclamation.
Make only tiny local EARTHWORKS changes: soften a narrow continuous graded ground corridor and gently level two existing dry industrial pads. This image must look almost identical to the source, with only subtle smooth low-contrast terrain leveling. It must not look like a railway photograph or a render of structures.
The route is centered on this smooth polyline in SOURCE IMAGE PIXELS measured from top left: (900,0),(970,60),(1045,104),(1070,140),(1070,195),(1060,240),(1040,290),(1028,330),(1020,390),(1018,455),(1020,515),(1038,570),(1060,620),(1070,680),(1090,738),(1120,790),(1130,830). Smooth these coordinates into continuous curves. The corridor is a SINGLE smooth graded ground strip about 12 pixels wide, blending very softly into the original ground over 10 pixels each side. It should have an even cross section, with small gradual cuts/fills. Gently smooth the existing source elevation down its length. Keep its gray very close to the immediately adjacent land. DO NOT draw paired rails, sleepers, a central line, sharp grooves, dark borders, bright raised edges, shadows, a uniform bright stripe, or an embossed path. Do not make a trench. No tracks or textures.
A short branch curves southwest from (1045,600) through (1015,640),(980,662), then west to (855,685). Grade this gently the same way. Level ONLY the existing dry land inside x850..990,y668..706 to a consistent gray value about 63, with 8-pixel smooth feathering that never spreads into source water. This is a flat station foundation, NOT platforms or building roof geometry.
Level ONLY existing dry ground inside x990..1040,y704..740 to gray about 63 with 8-pixel feathering; this is a depot foundation. No building silhouette, helipad, H, circle or roof.
Gently level the dry freight strip around x1080..1135,y745..827, but keep original water around its borders and nearby piers. Keep this near original lowland gray.
Black must remain black water, no new black channel. Light must remain high hills. The mountain ridge to the north and west remains exactly original. Major road bridges are separate future structures and must NOT be added to this ground heightmap.
Output ONE unannotated pure neutral grayscale heightmap only. No color cast, no text, no legend, no frame, no side panels, no graph, no railway artwork. Extremely subtle local elevation edits; preserve all the rest.

rejectedHeightmapAttempt.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: PROPOSED grayscale TERRAIN HEIGHTMAP for a 3D arcade game, for visual approval before numeric import.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: original 1536 x 1024 grayscale terrain heightmap. Input image 2 is the SUPPORTING ALIGNMENT REFERENCE: proposed color city map including the new railway, Central Station, freight sidings and a rooftop H.
OUTPUT ONLY ONE full-bleed grayscale heightmap 1536 x 1024 pixels in the exact original north-up, top-down pixel alignment. No text, legend, panels, rail texture, sleepers, painted tracks, buildings, shadows, helipad H, color, graphic overlays, lighting, contours, labels or perspective. This is elevation data, not a monochrome illustration.
Primary request: alter ONLY ground elevation along the new rail corridors and the station/depot/freight pads, accurately matching the railway position visible in input 2. Retain the entire original mountain terrain, coastline, islands, riverbanks, deep black water and all land outside these narrow edits. DO NOT redesign the landscape or shift the city or river. Darker gray is lower, lighter gray higher. Keep water black and land at existing realistic tonal levels.
Geometry from the ACTUAL proposed map, in pixel coordinates from upper left:
The main two-track rail corridor begins around (900,0), curves southeast through (970,60),(1045,104),(1070,140), descends gently south through (1070,195),(1060,240),(1040,290),(1028,330),(1020,390),(1018,455),(1020,515),(1038,570),(1060,620). These are alignment landmarks rather than hard corners: keep continuous broad curves. The actual rails in input 2 are the exact placement authority.
Create a smooth narrow 12..18 pixel-wide graded rail formation following that line, blending out over another 8..12 pixels. Smooth the elevation gently and continuously down toward the low southern city rather than introducing dark trenches or a flat bright stripe. In the northern foothills use modest cuts and fills and feathered banks. No abrupt kinks or elevation steps. Match the existing surrounding grayscale values.
At the southern junction around (1040,610), a passenger branch curves WEST through (1020,645),(985,662), then goes into the two straight terminal platforms spanning x850..985,y675..705. Create a modest flat station yard / concourse pad around x845..1000,y658..715, using the existing lowland gray, with softly feathered edges. Keep the shore west of x830 and water south/west untouched. Do NOT raise the ocean.
The freight branch continues southeast from (1040,610) through (1070,680),(1090,738),(1120,790), and two short sidings descend to around (1138,835) and (1075,830). Grade the narrow rail bed and small dry freight-yard pads smoothly, staying inside the existing Docklands land shape and clear of water between piers.
Flatten the depot foundation near x985..1045,y700..746 at compatible lowland elevation. The helipad is ON the BUILDING ROOF: do not encode its roof elevation, circle, H, or rooftop geometry into terrain.
Roads cross OVER the rails at the north and south freeways and the central airport bridge approach: grade only the ground rail formation underneath, do not create large terrain bumps that represent road bridge decks. Keep river water/seabed completely continuous; structures will be modeled separately later. At gated freight crossings the ground should be level with the adjoining yard.
Subtle, locally graded earthworks only; no embossing of railway lines, no bright white rail lines, no colored overlays. Preserve the source grayscale style, original water extent and all unrelated features exactly.
